review_manifest.full_page_review_source: six bounded page-group JPEG proxies plus two bounded centrality, citation, table, and modified-Katz crop proxies
transport_notes: Exactly one bounded JPEG was returned per image call.
No original full-page PNG entered model context.
All eight proxies fit one guarded context segment below 4 MiB.
The text layer covered all 20 pages; page-20 Conclusion text was recovered visually, and detail crops reconciled centrality, citation, table, and modified-Katz fidelity.

visual_records.exact_reading: The Summary moves from researcher centrality to citation methods, singer/actor tests, newcomer cost, and sensitivity.
visual_records.next_action: Check each branch against the relevant formula, table, and limitation.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Freeze the graph before interpreting ranks.
visual_records.exact_reading: The opening data pages identify the 511-vertex Erdos coauthor graph, 1713 edges, average degree 6.70, and the minor asymmetry repair.
visual_records.next_action: Release the raw edge list and repair sensitivity.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Turn sparse-graph statistics into a visualization decision.
visual_records.exact_reading: The spring-style layout shows 42 components and a 466-vertex largest component; the authors note that high-degree overlap is intrinsic rather than simply a drawing failure.
visual_records.next_action: Check component handling and layout stability.

visual_records.exact_reading: The displayed distance, surrogate, Laplacian, and iteration equations connect graph shortest paths to the physical layout.
visual_records.next_action: Retain the epsilon and monotonic-stress checks.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate mechanisms before choosing a winner.
visual_records.exact_reading: Degree and eigenvector scores are presented as different ways to value a node and are later compared with closeness and betweenness.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Keep path accessibility separate from neighbor prestige.
visual_records.exact_reading: The mean-distance and reciprocal-closeness definitions make access to the graph a distinct centrality question.
visual_records.next_action: State unreachable-node policy and graph direction.

visual_records.exact_reading: Fractional shortest-path betweenness and a simplified indicator are both shown; the text explains the server-time motivation for simplification.
visual_records.next_action: Compare the simplified indicator against the full metric on the same graph.

visual_records.exact_reading: ALON is first across the four displayed researcher measures, but the source treats this as a candidate rather than proof of hidden influence.
Citation direction i to j means paper i cites paper j; the directed graph is the object for the paper-level methods.
visual_records.next_action: Publish edge direction, duplicate rule, and dates.

visual_records.exact_reading: The two products select different papers—Barabasi 1999 for co-bibliography and Newman 2003 for co-citation—because they answer different directional questions.
The recurrence uses diminishing-return exponent p and a baseline b for uncited new papers, with p=.993 and b=.09 selected locally.
visual_records.next_action: Release initialization, convergence, and parameter traces.

visual_records.exact_reading: The singer/songwriter bipartite graph produces a coherent influential-singer reading because the songwriter relation supplies a plausible transmission path.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Use a failed transfer to define a boundary.
visual_records.exact_reading: The actor/movie bipartite result is described as messy; film popularity does not reliably carry influence back to actors, and the basic actor graph is retained as the less-bad option.
visual_records.next_action: Do not generalize the singer result to all bipartite networks.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Connect rank output to a feasible action.
visual_records.exact_reading: A newcomer has degree one and no internal betweenness, so eigenvector and closeness are used; brute-force selection of one partner is reported at about six hours.
visual_records.next_action: Report runtime, competition, and a safe alternative.

visual_records.exact_reading: Ten random five-edge additions/deletions move the top-five ranks by at most two; the source separately checks modified Katz convergence and local p/b behavior.
visual_records.next_action: Expand perturbations and report score/rank uncertainty.

visual_records.exact_reading: The source pairs four centralities, citation support, and application breadth with incomplete data, local sensitivity, and transfer limitations.
visual_records.next_action: Carry each limitation into the conclusion and downstream use.

visual_records.exact_reading: Visual recovery confirms that coauthor centrality is the most consistent researcher signal, citation methods disagree by construction, and applications are only moderately robust and require caution.
visual_records.next_action: Exclude the following References from positive prose evidence.
